observations.behavior: Adds resource argument to _blocked_and_allowed_object_ids, removing the resource_id-only grouping and passing the resource object instead.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the entry point for object-level access decisions; callers now supply the resource object rather than relying on the accessor to reconstruct it.

observations.behavior: Replaces resource_id->access_levels dict and per-resource filtering with rows_by_object_id and delegates object decision to _object_rows_decision; removes explicit access_level checks and replaces with row.subject and access_level checks.
observations.posthog_connection: Replaces the resource-level decision loop with an object-level decision, using a shared helper to avoid drift between queryset filtering and object-walk decisions.
